reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-random. I said I'd noted the correction: the signed order form for Tamsin Cold Chain is due 24 September, not 20 November as she posted in #north-team this morning.

I also pointed out that today is 14 October, so 24 September has already passed. Either the deadline was missed or the date is wrong, so I asked her to confirm the date and year.

My earlier reply under her #north-team post still says 20 November. I left it as it is because she said no action was needed, but I offered to add a correction there if she wants one.
